description: Two low frequency oscillators with morphing shapes, the first able to modulate the second.

params.text: Morphs the first oscillator's shape through triangle, sine, rounded square and square.
Morphs the second oscillator's shape through triangle, sine, rounded square and square.
Skews the first oscillator's shape, moving the peak towards one end of the cycle.
Skews the second oscillator's shape, moving the peak towards one end of the cycle.
Folds the first oscillator's output back on itself when it is driven past full scale.
How much the first oscillator modulates the second.
Chooses how the first oscillator reaches the second: up they are mixed, middle the first moves the second's rate, down the first moves the second's level.

inputs.text: A clock for the first oscillator: a rising edge restarts its cycle, and the FQ knob is then read as a division of that clock.
Holds the second oscillator's output at its present value while this is low, and lets it run while it is high.

outputs.text: The second oscillator, with whatever modulation the switch has selected applied.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.

inputs.0:
high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
